tagline.en: A password vault compatible with Bitwarden's protocol, light enough to run anywhere
tagline.pt: Cofre de senhas compatível com o protocolo do Bitwarden, leve o bastante pra rodar em qualquer lugar

notes.en:
Open `https://vaultwarden.<your-tailnet>.ts.net`.

The vault is reachable over the tailnet only. `PublishPort=8082:80` ships
commented out in the unit: publishing it would also answer to anyone on the
LAN, which is a wider door than a password vault needs. Uncomment it if you
want `http://<host-ip>:8082` too.
notes.pt:
Abrir `https://vaultwarden.<your-tailnet>.ts.net`.

O cofre é alcançável só pela tailnet. O `PublishPort=8082:80` vem comentado na
unit: publicar a porta faria ele atender também a qualquer um na LAN, que é
porta mais larga do que um cofre de senhas precisa. Descomente se quiser o
`http://<ip-do-host>:8082` também.

vaultwarden-admin-token.value: manual generate it with `podman run --rm vaultwarden/server:alpine /vaultwarden hash` and paste the hash
vaultwarden-admin-token.note: Vaultwarden expects the token's argon2 HASH, not the token in plain text.
